title: CO₂ Generator
keywords: Supplies carbon to a correctly aligned Flawless Greenhouse by burning fuel and consuming FE per fuel item

blocks.text: Supplies carbon to a correctly aligned Flawless Greenhouse by burning fuel and consuming FE per fuel item.

rows: Place it three blocks to the specified side of the Flawless controller, same facing.
Provide a valid fuel and enough FE for the entire fuel start.
Use Controlled Fuel for the configured high-carbon pause/resume behavior.

blocks.text: At the shipped values Controlled Fuel pauses at 100% and resumes at 92%, preserving paused burn time. Wrong position/facing prevents the intended link.

Read the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.
